'''2026 Retro Worlds Zach Stenerson DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Zach Stenerson]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Zach Stenerson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Objective:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster-decipher-archive.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26RWC Stenerson DS Court.txt |Download]]
